lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 6 -- When Does It Happen?

listenings.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Here is the calendar for this month. Our group meeting is on Monday, at ten in the morning. The meeting is one hour. In November we have the big event, and the program is on the website. The technical session is on Thursday, at three in the afternoon. Please put the dates in your calendar today. If you cannot come on Monday, please write to me before Friday. Thank you very much.

Hello, this is a short message about your schedule. Your first meeting is at nine in the morning, and it is thirty minutes. After that, you are free until noon. The team lunch is at half past twelve. In the afternoon there is one more meeting, at four o'clock. On Friday there is no meeting, so you have the day for your reports. Have a very good week.

paras: Dear team, here is our calendar for October. Please read it and put the dates in your own calendar this week.
The group meeting is on Monday, at ten in the morning. It is one hour, and it is online. We meet every two weeks.
The technical session is on Thursday, at three in the afternoon. It is in room four, and it is one hour and a half.
The big event is in November, in Belém. The program is on our website. There is no meeting on Friday, so you have the day for your reports.
